description: Where the parsed CSV lands in Unity Catalog.
_table_naming_note: Default table name is ef_csv_<filename>, with the extension dropped and anything non-alphanumeric folded to underscores. Set table_name_override to bypass that entirely.
_table_schema_note: null means derive the table schema from source_config.columns plus the ingestion metadata columns. Supply an explicit list of {name,type,nullable} only when the table must differ from the source.
_write_mode_note: append (default), or overwrite for a full replace each run.
